rows.question: Why can the same 30-day fill cost more at a standard pharmacy than a preferred one on this plan?
rows.answer: Preferred retail and standard retail are different cost-share categories, and the dated network classification for the pharmacy on the fill date selects the category. For this plan and period, a matched 30-day metformin 500 mg supply is $8 at preferred retail and $27 at standard retail under the recorded conditions. On 2026-08-18, you paid $8.00 for a 30-day metformin 500 mg fill at Oak Street Pharmacy. On 2026-09-16, you paid $27.00 for a 30-day metformin 500 mg fill at Lakeview Pharmacy.
